subject.title: [Bug]: Status card shows the active OAuth profile, but weekly usage appears to reflect a different Oauth credential

question: Should maintainers treat the open linked fork PR as the canonical fix path, or close it because current main's Codex synthetic usage path already covers this report?
rationale: Automation should not close this issue while an open PR references it with closing syntax, and deciding whether the newer main-only Codex path fully replaces the PR needs maintainer review of runtime coverage and release expectations.

options.title: Review or replace linked PR
options.body: Refresh the linked PR against current main or replace it with a narrow same-repo fix if the selected-profile usage contract is still missing outside the synthetic Codex path.

options.title: Close as current-main fixed
options.body: If maintainers confirm the July 5 status changes fully cover the reported multi-profile Codex setup, close this issue and the linked PR as implemented on main.

recommendation.title: Review or replace linked PR
recommendation.body: Refresh the linked PR against current main or replace it with a narrow same-repo fix if the selected-profile usage contract is still missing outside the synthetic Codex path.
